item.description: El presidente ruso, Vladímir Putin , ha llamado este viernes por la tarde al Papa León XIV , que permanece ingresado en el Hospital Gemelli tras la operación para extirparle un tumor maligno del pulmón. El Pontífice ha pedido al líder de Moscú « un alto el fuego para permitir la llegada de ayuda humanitaria» y se ha referido en particular a la «gravísima situación» de la ciudad de Oleshki, según ha informado el Vaticano.El Vicario de Cristo ha pedido al presidente ruso un alto el fuego para permitir « el suministro de alimentos y asistencia médica , así como la evacuación voluntaria y segura… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.

item.title: Cost-of-living demonstrations to grip pre-election France
item.description: After weeks of student protests, France is set to be swept by broader, nationwide demonstrations Saturday over the cost of living, setting up a potentially fraught period ahead of presidential elections next year. The prospect of the two movements merging, perhaps with outbreaks of violence, poses a big challenge to the government -- and an opportunity for far-left and far-right presidential candidates jockeying for power. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: India detains top 'cockroach' leader as hundreds protest in capital
item.description: Indian police detained Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) leader Abhijeet Dipke on Friday ahead of fresh protests demanding the removal of the country's election chief, the youth-led movement said in a social media post. Dipke, 31, was detained shortly before a rally called by the online movement in the heart of New Delhi where hundreds of protesters marched on Friday evening, despite heavy security measures. FRANCE 24's Navodita Kumari reports from New Delhi, India. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Zelensky hails "real leaders" in Europe, blasts Trump's diesel deal with Russia
item.description: Ukrainian ​President Volodymyr Zelensky took aim on Friday at US President Donald Trump's diesel deal with Russia and welcomed the prospect of European allies stepping up their role in talks, calling Moscow's stance a "parody" of peace negotiations. At a European Union summit in Brussels, Zelenskiy said Russia did not want peace. He added that Ukraine was still experiencing disruptions to the SpaceX Starshield satellite system. FRANCE 24's Europe Editor Armen Georgian reports from Brussels. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: France braces for massive protests: Yellow Vests to join students on Saturday
item.description: After weeks of student protests, France is set to be swept by broader, nationwide demonstrations on Saturday. The country's Yellow Vest movement – which eight years ago staged street protests against President Emmanuel Macron – has appealed to teachers, workers, pensioners and farmers, as well as students, in an online call spread through social media. The prospect of the two movements merging poses a big challenge to the government, as FRANCE 24’s Shirli Sitbon reports. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.description: Italy has extended by another week ​its suspension of the European Union's border-free travel arrangements with Spain over a surge in migrant arrivals in Ceuta in late July, ​an ‌Italian government source said on Friday. A ⁠Spanish government spokesperson said the interior ministers of both countries would work over ‌the coming week on lifting the border controls. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: REPLAY: Ukraine's Zelensky holds presser in Brussels
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky on Friday urged European leaders to maintain their support for Kyiv and warned against easing sanctions on Russia. Speaking to reporters at the European summit in Brussels, Zelensky said that ending the war remained Ukraine’s priority but accused Russian President Vladimir Putin of having no genuine interest in negotiations. He also criticised a US deal involving Russian diesel, arguing that easing restrictions could allow Moscow to reap financial benefits and pave the way for broader sanctions relief. Watch the replay. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: US voters want action on global heating. So why are midterm candidates ‘climate hushing’?
item.description: Polls show that Democrats and Republicans in battleground states want to hear more from candidates about the climate crisis Most Americans feel unease or alarm about the climate crisis and, in both red and blue states, want to know how political leaders are going to fix it. But in midterm election campaigns across the US, candidates have responded to this desire with near silence. People in the US have this year endured a record hot summer as well as soaring costs, equating to roughly $2,000 per household , in extra energy and mortgage payments, due to the country’s dependence on a fossil… Fuente: The Guardian - Environment.

item.description: Estados Unidos está considerando utilizar contra Irán su bomba no nuclear más grande si el presidente Donald Trump decide reanudar los combates en la guerra, que se encuentra en punto muerto, según ha informado este CNN el jueves.El Ejército evalúa el posible uso de la bomba GBU-43/B Massive Ordnance Air Blast (MOAB), más conocida como la 'madre de todas las bombas' , para atacar infraestructuras energéticas iraníes y sitios nucleares, según el medio, que cita a funcionarios familiarizados con el tema.Trump intenta mejorar sus bajos índices de popularidad de cara a las elecciones legislativas… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.
